hints: When you reach a `]`, which part of the answer does the count apply to, and where did that part begin?
It applies to everything built since the matching `[`. So at each `[` you need to set the current text aside and start a fresh one.
Two stacks: one of the counts waiting to be applied, one of the partial texts waiting to be resumed. A `[` pushes both; a `]` pops both and joins.
A count can have more than one digit, so accumulate it as `count * 10 + digit` until the `[` arrives.
